Multi-Department Clinical Corpus
303 real-world inpatient & outpatient cases
Collected across 12 clinical specialties
Preserve gold standard diagnostic journeys

Three-Station Case Structuring
Transform narratives into sequential stations:
Station 1 Inquiry · Station 2 Lab · Station 3 Diagnosis
Align temporal clinical progression

OSCE Inquiry Checklist Annotation
Extract 8,857 standardized inquiry items
Average 29.23 checklist checkpoints per case
Annotate clinical questioning logic

Evidence Criticality Gate
Classify inquiry evidence level:
Level 2 Critical Core vs Level 1 Supplementary
Assign clinical priority weights

Unified Lab Action Catalog
Standardize 38 clinical examination categories
Tag each test as Essential or Optional
Establish ICD-10 diagnostic ground truth

ScanBench Interactive Benchmark
303 annotated clinical consultation scenarios
Full simulated patient dialogue profiles
Standardized OSCE test selection and diagnostic targets

Standardized Patient Interaction
Model conducts dynamic multi-turn inquiry
Standardized patient simulator reveals symptoms
Tracks conversational information gathering

OSCE & SCAN Framework Scoring
Evaluate inquiry against 8,857 items via GPT-4.1
Compute 4-dimensional SCAN rubric:
Safety · Clarification · Association · Normative

Auxiliary Test Selection Gate
Does patient require further examination?
Select tests from 38 categories vs Skip to diagnosis
Route action to testing evaluation

Weighted Test F1 Evaluation
Measure essential vs optional test selection
Penalize redundant and missed critical examinations
Compute Weighted F1 with high essential recall weight

Hierarchical ICD-10 Diagnosis Matching
Output primary differential and final diagnosis
Match hierarchically across ICD-10 chapters & subcategories
Score clinical diagnostic precision

ScanBench Clinical Scorecard
Inquiry OSCE coverage & SCAN radar profile
Lab test selection efficiency & diagnostic accuracy
Holistic medical agent decision capability report
